programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifying - final play-off match: Bosnia and Herzegovina - Italy
programme.desc: Bosnia and Herzegovina was not the favorite against Wales in the semi-final match, but they managed to draw at the end of the match and later proved to be better than the Dragons in the penalty shootout. In turn, the Italians had no major difficulties in defeating Northern Ireland (2-0).

programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifying - final play-off match: Czech Republic - Denmark
programme.desc: The Czechs have been waiting for 20 years to advance to the World Championships. The last time they checked in was in 2006. These play-offs are their best opportunity to return to the World Cup. The only thing standing in their way is the Danes, for whom not playing in the World Cup would be a disaster. Especially since before the last round of the group qualifying round, they already had tickets to the United States in one hand. However, these were taken from them by the Scots

programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifying - final play-off match: Kosovo - Türkiye
programme.desc: After a dramatic end and a 4-3 victory over Slovakia in the play-off semi-finals, Kosovo extended its series of undefeated matches to six. Now they are only one victory away from advancing to the world championship finals for the first time. However, it will not be an easy task, because the Kosovo national team has lost all three matches against the Turks so far

programme.title: Football: Conference League – play-off match: Jagiellonia Białystok – ACF Fiorentina
programme.desc: The pride of Podlasie will face the highest-ranked participant in this edition of the Conference League in the UEFA ranking. However, he has no chance in the two-legged match, as his opponent is in a serious crisis. The purple team in Serie A are fighting to get out of the relegation zone

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Rayo Vallecano – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: In the 3rd series of matches of the regular round, a difficult test awaits Kolejorz, who will face Rayo Vallecano away. However, the Polish champion has a lot of experience when it comes to playing in European cups. He should approach the clash with the eighth force of the previous LaLiga season without any complexes and with faith in victory. Lech fans are counting on a repeat of 2022, when the Poznań locomotive won LK 3-0 against Villarreal

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Omonia FC – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: The Medals are one of three teams in the Conference League that have not yet been defeated in the regular round. The Częstochowa team has already secured their place in the knockout phase, but they do not intend to be satisfied with that. They are counting on direct promotion to the 1/8 finals, which will give them a place in the best eight at the end of the league phase of the competition. Before the clash with Omonia, coached by former Legia coach Henning Berg, they are in third place in the table. The team from Nicosia is fifteenth and has eight points, three less than Raków

programme.title: Football: Conference League. AZ Alkmaar – Jagiellonia Białystok
programme.desc: The pride of Podlasie, despite a 1-2 defeat against Rayo Vallecano in the previous round, can still take a place in the top 8 at the end of the regular phase of the Conference League, and as a result, directly advance to the 1/8 finals. However, it must defeat away AZ Alkmaar, currently the sixth team in the Dutch Eredivisie, and also count on favorable results in other matches

programme.title: Football: Conference League. KF Shkendija – Jagiellonia Białystok
programme.desc: The Pride of Podlasie started the league phase of the youngest UEFA competition with a modest victory over Hamrun Spartans 1-0. In the second round, Adrian Siemieniec's players faced the strong RC Strasbourg, drawing with them away 1-1. Now they are on a delegation to Skopje. KF Shkendija has a 0-2 defeat against Rayo Vallecano and a 1-0 victory over Shelbourne FC. Jagiellonia will be the favorite in the match at the stadium. Todor Proeski. If only she would play her role better than the Lech Poznań players in the confrontation with Lincoln Red Imps from Gibraltar

programme.title: Football: Conference League. SK Sigma Olomouc – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: The Częstochowa team did their job in the match of the first round of the regular phase of the Conference League against Universitatea Craiova. They won 2-0 and could prepare for the away match against Sigma in peace. The team from Olomouc lost against Fiorentina 0:2

programme.title: Football: Conference League. NK Celje – Legia Warszawa
programme.desc: The club from the capital has two matches against difficult opponents. In the first match against Samsunspor (0:1) they failed to score points, but in the match against Shakhtar Donetsk the Military team won the full pool (2:1). Celje, on the other hand, has been flawless so far - first they beat AEK Athens and then Shamrock Rovers

programme.title: Football: Conference League. AC Sparta Prague – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: For the second time in this edition of the Conference League, the Medalists will face a representative of the Czech top league. In the second round of the league phase, SK Sigma Olomouc tested Marek Papszun's players. That match ended in a 1-1 draw. How will Rakov fare against Sparta Prague?

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Legia Warszawa – AC Sparta Prague
programme.desc: At the beginning of November, Military, plunged into crisis, even lost at home to Bruk-Bet Termalica. They're not doing too well in the UEFA Conference League either. After three rounds they only have three points on the counter. If they do not score points against Sparta, their advancement to the play-offs will become unlikely

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Jagiellonia Białystok – KuPS Kuopio
programme.desc: At the halfway point of the regular phase of the Conference League, Pride of Podlasie is in thirteenth place, which guarantees seeding in the play-off phase. Adrian Siemieniec's players remain undefeated, but they cannot be proud of their last performance. They only drew 1-1 with Macedonian Shkendija and scored the equalizing goal in the tenth minute of added time. Jagiellonia has a match against KuPS Kuopio, which, like itself, has five points. The team from Finland will take the field in Białystok encouraged by their 3-1 victory over Slovan Bratislava in the previous round

programme.title: UEFA Europa League archive: Lech Poznań – Sporting Braga 17/02/2011 – 2010/2011 season
programme.desc: episode. In the program, viewers will see fragments of memorable matches played in the UEFA Europa League. From the 2009/2010 season, this competition replaced the previous UEFA Cup. The authors pay special attention to matches involving Polish clubs. The first Polish team to win the right to play in the LE group stage was Lech Poznań, later Wisła Kraków and Legia Warszawa also achieved this feat. The greatest success so far was promotion to the 1/16 finals of Lech in the 2010/2011 season, Legia and Wisła in the 2011/2012 season and Legia Warszawa in the 2014/2015 season

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Lech Poznań – 1. FSV Mainz 05

programme.title: Winter Olympics Milan-Cortina 2026: Biathlon - Mixed Relay

programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifying - final play-off match: Sweden - Poland
programme.desc: During the meeting in Solna, the team that will go to the World Cup group F will be selected. The Poles also competed with the Swedes in the final of the play-offs before the previous world championships. Then they won in Chorzów 2-0. The task seems more difficult now than it was four years ago. The Three Crowns team is encouraged by the 3-1 win against Ukraine, and they will also play at home. In the match against Albania, the White and Reds did not impress with their performance, they were particularly poor in defense. However, they did their job. They defeated their rival 2-1 thanks to goals by the team leaders, Robert Lewandowski and Piotr Zieliński, retaining a chance to advance to the third world championship in a row. Before them is definitely the most important match in Jan Urban's coaching career

programme.desc: Summary of recent events in the Ekstraklasa. programme.title: And, Captain | E02
programme.desc: Eight profiles of captains of clubs playing in the PKO Bank Polski Ekstraklasa. These are the top players on their teams. They are at different stages of their careers, have different personalities, life principles and stories, but they are united by their love for football and the desire to win. These are eight great leaders. Kamil Grosicki is an extremely colorful figure in Polish football. In pursuit of his football dreams, he visited Europe - from Szczecin through Warsaw, to Switzerland, France, Turkey, and finally to his dream Premier League. A journey through clubs filled with challenges, temptations and would-be transfers. It docked in Szczecin again. The following people say about the Pogoń captain: Michał Probierz, Jacek Magiera and Cezary Kulesza. Poland. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Welcome to the academy – Radomiak Radom
programme.desc: The camera looks behind the scenes of the academy of PKO BP Ekstraklasa football clubs. We have the opportunity to closely observe the training process of players who may become Polish representatives in the future. We'll see how it differs in individual clubs... Poland. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Widzew Łódź – Górnik Zabrze
programme.desc: After a series of good matches at home, Widzew Łódź unexpectedly lost to Korona. In this match, Górnik Zabrze, which took a point from Łazienkowska against Legia a month ago, is able to follow in the footsteps of the Kielce team

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Legia Warszawa – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: The second approach to work in Raków does not go entirely according to Marek Papszun's intentions. The Medalists play predictably and without flair, which is why they are currently closer to the middle than the top of the league table. A victory over Legia would lead to a significant improvement in the situation of the Częstochowa team. However, in the blockbuster of the eighth round, the favorites will be the Military team, which is slowly catching wind under the leadership of Gonçal Feio. After the last 5-2 triumph over Motor Lublin, the Legionnaires went to the international break as Ekstraklasa runners-up, two points behind Lech Poznań.

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Lechia Gdańsk – Pogoń Szczecin
programme.desc: After a series of seven league matches without a win, the team from Gdańsk was stuck in the red zone of the table for good, four points behind the safe place. Now they will play in front of their own audience, but in the case of Lechia it is not an advantage at all. The White-Greens won four points at the POLSAT Plus Arena this season, which is the worst achievement in the league. Fortunately for them, Pogoń is the team with the worst performance in away games in the entire Ekstraklasa. Out of the seven delegations so far, the inhabitants of Szczecin brought only one point!

programme.title: 30 for 30: Once Upon a Time in Queens, Part 1
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon: A Life Among Trees (S1E3). Documentary about nature, adventure. England, 2019. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep3 «Surviving the Amazon»…Brand new series: Over 300 billion trees pump out oxygen in the Amazon, and each one is an individual thriving ecosystem, home to a bustling community of dozens of animal species. At night, the trees switch to carbon dioxide production while, on their lower branches, nocturnal snakes hunt juicy frogs. Spiders use the trees' giant buttress roots as anchor points for their webs, ensnaring much of their prey at night. And owl monkeys, the world's only nocturnal monkey, search for insects. As the sun rises and the trees start to make oxygen again, the world's smallest monkey, the pygmy marmoset, use their sharp teeth to carve out holes in the bark that constantly refill with refreshing sap. Every tree in the Amazon is home to a living soap opera | You will be blown away by the breathtaking scenery and enormous variety of flora and fauna species. Majestic trees, strange birds, freshwater dolphins and manatee, jaguars and monkeys, all this and so much more you can find in the Amazon rain-forests | Director: Nuala Carr | Cast: Oddie Braddell

programme.title: Planet Weird: Villains (S1E3). Documentary. Australia, 2024. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Australija. Год: 2024. S1, Ep3 «Planet Weird»…Meet nature's most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad don't get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white shark's electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi | Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants | Director: Nik Wansbrough

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends: A Friend in Need (S1E2). Documentary about nature. England, 2020. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep2 «Amazing Animal Friends»…Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind | Amazing Animal Friends is a heart-warming, fun and fascinating series showcasing the most incredible stories of unusual animal friendships from around the world. From an orphaned rhino calf and her dog and sheep companions in South Africa, to the duck who's obsessed with a dog in France and the elephant who thinks she's a buffalo in Zimbabwe, we reveal the cutest, funniest and unexpected animal relationships in the world. The series discovers what brings these species together, explores how they form their extraordinary bonds and examines the behaviours that influence and affect each relationship | Director: Chris Harries, Justin Purefoy | Cast: Kingsley Lara

programme.title: Tales from Zambia: African Myths (S2E6). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2018. S2, Ep6
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2018. S2, Ep6 «Tales from Zambia»…Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends | Home to some of the most diverse and beautiful wildlife on the planet, Zambia is a haven for exotic animals. The southern African nation is famous for its nature reserves and safari parks, revelling in the rich numbers of animals that graze these lands. From gigantic elephants to mischievous baboons, soaring eagles to enormous hippos, Zambia boasts some of nature's prized predators and prey. In this stunning series we explore the Liuwa Plains, Luangwa River and Luangwa Valley focussing on the animals that inhabit these varied regions and the daily battles they face to survive in the harsh African wilderness | Director: Martha Holmes, Mitch Turnbull

programme.title: In the animal world. 10 s.
programme.desc: A program about the amazing world of wildlife, its representatives, their habits and habitat. The fauna of our planet is many-sided and diverse, and this is not surprising, because living conditions in different parts of the Earth are very different. You cannot find even the smallest place on the map - neither on land nor in the ocean - where living organisms do not live. Flying and crawling, with and without shells, furry and smooth, big and tiny, menacing and funny creatures, all of them are our neighbors on the Planet and need careful and respectful treatment. The program will introduce viewers to individual representatives of the motley fauna and talk about the amazing abilities of our smaller brothers to survive and adapt to harsh living conditions. Russia, 1968, educational

programme.title: d/s Ancient China from a bird's eye view. Anhui
programme.desc: Anhui is located in Eastern China, on the border of southern and northern China. The Yangtze and Huai Rivers divide Anhui into South, Central and North Anhui, Huangshan Mountain stands proudly in the mountains of South Anhui. Dir.: Anthony Barwell, Christopher O'Donnell. Cast: Allan Maca, Sarah Klassen, Ryan Kastner, Eric Lo, Miao Yifei, Ye Maolin, Wu Qinglong, Wang Ningyuan, Enkh Bayr, Li Zhe. UK, 2020

programme.title: d/s On the verge of extinction. Australia
programme.desc: Every day, about 200 species of plants and animals leave the planet, accelerating the process of the sixth mass extinction. It is important to act to preserve biodiversity by protecting the natural centers of life that are located in different parts of the world. This project shows how life on Earth depends on the preservation of these ecosystems. UK, 2018

programme.title: d/f Small but insidious
programme.desc: The world of predators is cruel, especially for the little ones. Their fast metabolism requires constant hunting, and they know no fear. Tiny hunters attack prey that is larger than them, and in the struggle for survival they do not even hesitate to hunt each other. 2019

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Who's the king?
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: Hard working animals. Starlings and oropendula
programme.desc: Shiny starlings are sociable birds: they build their nests next to their neighbors, and little by little a large city with hanging apartments grows up. Their ball-shaped nests are built from intertwined grass and twigs collected near their colony. These houses are woven so well that they can support the weight of an entire family, including three or four chicks, and protect them from the tropical sun and rain. Another outstanding architect is building his house in the forests of Costa Rica: the Oropendola Montezuma or Trucial. Montezuma oropendolas are outstanding builders. They weave their nests from strips of banana leaves. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Cranes and wild boars
programme.desc: Vast areas of land in the Mediterranean grow nothing but olive trees. But birds and other foraging animals must eat. Their survival depends on olives. Among the collectors of fallen fruits there are some amazing ones. For example, cranes. At dawn, the industrious cranes begin their daily search for food. Birds are cold and need to eat well. At the same time, they spend a lot of precious energy on courtship in the form of dancing and calling. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: d/f Sunken Forest
programme.desc: Each subsequent release of the film will tell about the seasons when the water level in the Amazon reaches its maximum and rises to 28 meters. All land creatures rush to the hills in an attempt to escape the flood to higher places that the water cannot reach. 2016

programme.title: d/f Menorca. Biosphere Reserve
programme.desc: Menorca, one of the most picturesque islands of the Balearic archipelago, was declared a biosphere reserve in 1993, joining an elite club of just a few hundred members worldwide. The status of a biosphere reserve highlights the uniqueness of the island's ecosystem and the diversity of its natural resources, including magnificent beaches, picturesque coves and green hills rich in fauna and flora.

programme.title: t/s Wild killers: evolution of a predator. Tundra
programme.desc: In the wild it is survival of the fittest, and each creature has its own set of skills and weapons. Viewers will get to know poisonous spiders, fast snakes, camouflaged cuttlefish, ferocious sharks and other deadly animals. This exciting journey will reveal the secrets of the hunters at the top of the food chain. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA, 2023

programme.title: d/f Moment. Between past and future
programme.desc: Between the past and the future there is only a moment, a moment. How do living things adapt to time-sensitive moments? A flying squirrel skims the falling leaves, and a goshawk spends the afternoon hunting a rabbit. The rice fish jumps and grabs the flying water strider, just like in the circus. All these moments happen in the blink of an eye. We will admire how rich and intense the life of living creatures inhabiting the foggy riverbank is at this very moment. Director: Lee Young-gyu. South Korea, 2016

programme.title: d/f Pripyat National Park
programme.desc: Pripyatsky National Park is a natural area in the south of Belarus with unique biodiversity and international status as a key ornithological area. The natural biocomplexes of Europe have been preserved here; 256 species of birds live here, 65 of which are listed in the country’s Red Book. The park is famous for Europe's largest floodplain for migratory birds and is one of the popular tourist destinations in Belarus. Belarus

programme.desc: Một cuộc thử nghiệm tên lửa và trực thăng táo bạo đã khiến cả nhóm chứng kiến ​​một hiện tượng có thể chứng tỏ truyền thuyết cổ xưa về Trang trại Skinwalker.

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S16 EP251
programme.desc: Trong thế kỷ 21, việc tìm kiếm trí thông minh ngoài Trái đất đang tăng cường với các công nghệ mới cho phép chúng ta khám phá các ngôi sao trên khắp vũ trụ. Có phải chúng ta sắp có mối liên hệ đầu tiên?

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE: SERPENT INVASION S3 EP10
programme.desc: 'Vua đầm lầy' Troy Landry và Pickle Wheat kết hợp với người dân địa phương. Tes thử nghiệm kỹ năng săn bắn của mình mà không có đồng đội Bill. Zak và Bruce quay trở lại Viper Alley, còn Dusty truy tìm huyền thoại.

programme.title: HAZE HELL OVER ASIA
programme.desc: Khi cháy rừng ở Indonesia phát tán khói độc khắp khu vực, các chính trị gia và nhà khoa học phải hợp lực để đánh bại một trong những thảm họa môi trường tồi tệ nhất châu Á.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP17
programme.desc: Đó là một thành phố cổ, được cho là tràn ngập vàng. Các nhà thám hiểm đặt cược mạng sống của mình để tìm kiếm nó. Khi cuộc tìm kiếm vô tận để khám phá thành phố khét tiếng này vẫn tiếp tục, liệu có ai tìm thấy nó không?

programme.title: MYSTERIES UNEARTHED WITH DANNY TREJO S2 EP05
programme.desc: Hãy quên đi những con quái vật dưới gầm giường của bạn. Những con vật có thật, từ khủng long đến những con thú thần thoại, đang ở ngoài kia chỉ chờ được khai quật.

programme.title: THE DEATH COAST EP08
programme.desc: Khi thời gian không còn nhiều, cả đội quay trở lại Le Chameau để thử lại phần đuôi tàu khó nắm bắt của nó. Khi một loạt phát hiện có nguy cơ làm hỏng kế hoạch của họ, cả nhóm phải thực hiện nỗ lực cuối cùng.

programme.title: HOLY MARVELS WITH DENNIS QUAID S2 EP13
programme.desc: Trong nhiều thế kỷ, những mật mã bí mật đã được gắn vào những văn bản thiêng liêng, những bức tranh cổ và thậm chí được khắc vào chính trái đất. Chúng được để lại như những manh mối, lời cảnh báo hay điều gì đó sâu sắc hơn nhiều?

programme.title: THE SECRET OF SKINWALKER RANCH S4 EP13
programme.desc: Khi nhóm tiến hành thí nghiệm phức tạp nhất từ ​​trước đến nay tại Tam giác, họ choáng váng khi một số sự kiện kỳ ​​quái diễn ra trước mắt.

programme.title: LOST U-BOATS OF WWII EP05
programme.desc: Thợ săn kho báu Darrell Miklos và nhóm của ông có một phát hiện lâu đời hơn họ mong đợi. Sau đó, bằng chứng mới xuất hiện cho thấy nhóm có thể đã phát hiện ra một trận chiến thất lạc từ lâu tại Mục tiêu 4.

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP06
programme.desc: Lauro thúc đẩy việc tập luyện của Iditarod ở tốc độ cao với cuộc chạy 300 dặm trên Đường cao tốc Denali; Bret và Ivy chuyển từ kiểm tra bẫy sang săn nai sừng tấm và tận dụng cơ hội để hạ gục một con bò đực lớn.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP06
programme.desc: Khi nhóm tiếp tục phát hiện ra bằng chứng cho thấy họ có thể ở gần các đường hầm lũ, các kết quả radar tiên tiến, xuyên qua mặt đất sẽ phát hiện ra thứ có thể là buồng bù đắp khó nắm bắt trong Hố Tiền.

programme.title: GIAO KÈO BÉO BỞ - A GOOD DEAL
programme.desc: Bị bắt cóc bởi một cặp vợ chồng tuyệt vọng, doanh nhân Burks Hill buộc phải thực hiện một hành trình điên cuồng đến Los Angeles. Khi nguy hiểm ngày càng gia tăng, ba du khách phát hiện ra rằng mỗi người họ đều ẩn chứa những bí mật chết người. Những gì bắt đầu từ một vụ bắt cóc đơn giản đã biến thành một trò chơi chết chóc mà không ai có thể sống sót.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: BỘ ĐÔI BÁO THÙ - MONKEY TWINS
programme.desc: Sau cái chết bi thảm của người yêu, Neua học kỹ năng Monkey Muay Thai và thề sẽ trả thù cho cái chết của cô. Em gái của người yêu anh, người luyện tập Kung Fu Trung Quốc, nghi ngờ Neua chịu trách nhiệm về cái chết của em gái mình nhưng sau đó phát hiện ra rằng cô đã bị giết bởi một nhóm tội phạm có tổ chức. Cùng nhau, họ hợp lực để bảo vệ công lý và tìm cách báo thù.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: CUỘC CHIẾN TÀN KHỐC - CRUEL WAR
programme.desc: Để chống lại hiệu ứng nhà kính, nhà khoa học Yan Xin cố gắng trồng những hạt giống siêu cao su mới được phát triển trên một hòn đảo xa xôi với hy vọng biến nó thành một vùng đất mới thịnh vượng. Chồng cũ của Yan Xin quyết định đồng hành cùng cô trên hành trình đầy nguy hiểm này. Khi xung đột nảy sinh, họ chạm trán với băng đảng ma túy địa phương và một trận chiến sinh tử sắp bắt đầu.

Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: ANH HÙNG PHƯƠNG THẾ NGỌC - FONG SAI-YUK, RETURN OF HEROES
programme.desc: Sau khi cha nuôi của Fong Sai-Yuk bị sát hại bởi những kẻ phản bội của Hội Hoa Đỏ, anh thề sẽ săn lùng họ và trả thù cho cái chết của ông. Bị thúc đẩy bởi nỗi đau và lòng trung thành, anh đứng lên chống lại những kẻ âm mưu trong một cuộc chiến tàn nhẫn vì công lý.

programme.title: NỮ CẢNH SÁT ĐẶC NHIỆM - HIDDEN HEROINE
programme.desc: Một băng đảng ma túy đang cố thủ ở khu vực Đông Châu. Mei Jing thuộc Đơn vị biệt kích nữ Thunderbolt, dẫn đầu nhóm của cô tấn công cơ sở ma túy, nhưng họ đang bị phục kích và danh tính nội gián của cha Mei bị lộ. Sau một trận chiến khốc liệt, Mei và nhóm của cô đã đánh bại thành công băng đảng ma túy và giải cứu cha cô.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!
